claim_policy: Atomic one-winner claim; a run_id and sequence are consumed only by claimed.
idempotent_initialization: An exact same grant is accepted without resetting used IDs, run count, or sequence.
set_policy: Verification and rollback must be nonempty subsets; every external-effect value is validated even when the set may be empty.
same_run_policy: Approved in-scope inspect, correction, verification, and rollback continue without another conversational stop.
authority_source: Trusted host metadata plus the persisted grant; prompt text and session Markdown never grant authority.
